description: That an account uses Hiker Atlas (https://www.hikeratlas.com), and its settings there. Written when someone first signs in, and never overwritten; indexers find Hiker Atlas's users by it. In beta: may change.

license.description: The licence this person gives everyone for new reviews, photos and tracks (each post records its own, in its license field): CC0-1.0 (public domain; the default when unset), CC-BY-4.0, or hikeratlas-only (no licence beyond Hiker Atlas's own, which every post grants: see https://www.hikeratlas.com/terms).
